setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 loops 8 steps on the test device with Merge Shape set to Foundation. Pattern 1 (C, D, E, F, MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65, velocities 127, 117, 107, 97, on steps 1 to 4) is saved as the protected Anchor: its steps always play as written. Pattern 2 (a C at velocity 100 on steps 5 and 7) offers additions. Add amount is how many additions are admitted and Add accent scales their velocity. The norns shows the Rhythm page and the grid lights steps 1 to 5 and 7.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Add amount, which reads 100: every candidate addition is admitted. Turn E2 two detents on to Add accent, which reads 70 and scales the velocity of the added trigs to 70 percent. Both settings are already at these values; you only read them here. The grid shows the anchors on steps 1 to 4 and the additions on steps 5 and 7.
steps.title: Read Add amount and Add accent

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two eight-step loops sound, then tap Stop. Each loop plays the four anchors, MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97, then two additions as MIDI 60 at velocity 70, shown in the strip below. Anchor velocities are untouched; only the added notes use Add accent.
steps.title: Hear anchors and additions

steps.caption: Turn E3 left 30 detents. Add accent reads 40; press K3 to apply it, as the sequencer is stopped.
steps.title: Lower Add accent to 40

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two loops sound, then tap Stop. The four anchors are exactly as before, MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97, but the two additions are now MIDI 60 at velocity 40 in the strip below, quieter than the 70 you heard before.
steps.title: Hear quieter additions

title: Keep anchors and accent the additions
